run.rehearsal_agent: work/ros2_collection/envs/ros_jazzy/bin/python tools/ros2_collection/local_car_rehearsal.py --root /tmp/lelab_car_rehearsal (port 18115, ROS_DOMAIN_ID 57, feedback 50 Hz, camera 14.74 Hz, 64x48 frames)

warnings: phase 1 export is arm+gripper only: the locked chassis is excluded rather than zero-filled
action is the post-clamp target the gateway sent; the leader reading is recorded separately and is not the action

dataset sampled at 15 Hz because the video encoder requires a whole-number rate; the profile declared 14.74 Hz

page_readback.api: dataset_viewer.list_episodes / video_path / episode_timeseries on the exported dataset dir
page_readback.shared_video_file: videos/observation.images.wrist_real/chunk-000/file-000.mp4 (both episodes live in this one file)

defect_found_by_the_read_back.what: LeRobot v3 put both episodes in the same mp4 and dataset_viewer correctly reported from_s/to_s, but DatasetViewer.tsx built the player URL as `.../video/<camera>#t=<from_s>` with no end. Episode 0 therefore played on past its own frames into episode 1's footage, and with `loop` it looped over the whole file. Nothing in the previous assertions could see this: the old check only asked whether a video path resolved, which is true for both episodes of one shared file.
defect_found_by_the_read_back.why_it_matters: 八.7 asks the page to read the data back for 数据检查. A reviewer who cannot tell where an episode ends cannot check the clip against the series, and would judge a teleop episode on frames belonging to the next one.
defect_found_by_the_read_back.fix: app_ros_mobile/frontend/src/pages/DatasetViewer.tsx now emits `#t=<from_s>,<to_s>` (Media Fragment start,end) so the player both seeks to and stops at the episode boundary; the range is still shown in the card header.
defect_found_by_the_read_back.regression_pin: tools/ros2_collection/local_full_chain_sync_export.py gained page_can_locate_each_episode_inside_the_shared_file: ranges must exist for every episode, be contiguous inside the shared file, and each span must equal length/fps within 0.05 s.

mutation_check.how: dataset_viewer.py's `to_timestamp` branch was renamed so no episode records a to_s, then the two page assertions were recomputed against the same exported dataset.
mutation_check.result: contiguous -> False, range_length_match -> False, while video_path still resolved True for both episodes. The pre-existing assertion is blind to this failure mode; only the new one reacts.
mutation_check.restored: dataset_viewer.py returned to its committed content (grep for the marker: 0 hits, git diff empty).
